Cached position multipliers, warning on any gap

Source: R/estimated_skills.R
dot-resolve_position_multipliers.Rd

Returns decay_params$position_multipliers (or computes all of them from dt when none are cached). Stats missing from the cache are NOT filled from dt, because callers pass slices and a per-slice multiplier would differ between training and serving; they get a warning instead. Skills step 02b caches every detected stat (review R015: the 2026-09 cache covered 52 of 88, so a back-up keeper's saves shrank toward the all-player mean 0.15 per 90 rather than the keeper mean 1.76).

Usage

.resolve_position_multipliers(decay_params, dt, stat_cols)

Arguments

decay_params

Decay parameters, possibly holding position_multipliers.

dt

Match-level stats with a position column.

stat_cols

Stats that need a multiplier.

Value

Named list of position multipliers.
